html:
Hello,

Sorry the meeting link isn't working. A couple of quick things to try:

  • Open the link in your browser and choose Continue on this browser.
  • Make sure you are signed in with your district account, not a personal one.
  • If it still fails, close Teams completely and reopen it, then click the link again.

If none of that helps, send me the exact error message and I'll dig in.
